title: A turbofan, cut open
alt: A 3D model of a turbofan, its axis horizontal, air flowing left to right, cut open to show the inside: the intake lip and inlet cowl, the fan case and fan cowl doors, the thrust reverser sleeve and cascades, the spinner, fan disc and 24 fan blades, the outlet guide vanes, the 3-stage low-pressure and 6-stage high-pressure compressors, each stage a row of rotor blades and a row of stator vanes, the compressor case, the ring-shaped combustor with its liners, 20 fuel nozzles and two igniters, the combustor case, the high-pressure turbine and the 4-stage low-pressure turbine, the turbine case, two nested shafts, the exhaust nozzle and cone; outside, the accessory gearbox, fuel pump, starter, oil tank, oil pipe, wiring harness and two mounts. Casings, stators and the combustor come in two halves that can be seen through and taken apart sideways.

parts.name: Intake lip
parts.note: the thick round rim at the front of the nacelle: air enters the engine smoothly, without swirling.

parts.name: Intake lip (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the intake lip.

parts.name: Inlet cowl
parts.note: the section of nacelle ahead of the fan; its inside is lined with a sound-absorbing layer that quietens the fan.

parts.name: Inlet cowl (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the inlet cowl.

parts.name: Fan case
parts.note: the outer case round the fan, its inside close to the blade tips. Behind it, the bypass air flows in the duct between the nacelle and the core casing.

parts.name: Fan case (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the fan case.

parts.name: Fan cowl doors
parts.note: two doors that open round the fan case, so mechanics can reach the equipment fixed outside it.

parts.name: Fan cowl doors (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the fan cowl doors.

parts.name: Thrust reverser sleeve
parts.note: the rear of the nacelle. On landing it slides back and opens the cascades, which turn the bypass air forwards to help slow the aeroplane.

parts.name: Thrust reverser sleeve (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the thrust reverser sleeve.

parts.name: Reverser cascades
parts.note: rows of turning vanes under the reverser sleeve, on the inner wall of the bypass duct; they show only when the sleeve slides back.

parts.name: Reverser cascades (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the reverser cascades.

parts.name: Outlet guide vanes
parts.note: 36 vanes standing still in the bypass duct (two halves of 18), straightening the swirling air behind the fan; they also hold the nacelle to the core casing.

parts.name: Outlet guide vanes (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the outlet guide vanes.

parts.name: Spinner
parts.note: leads the air smoothly into the fan, and turns with it.

parts.name: Fan disc
parts.note: the steel disc on the low-pressure shaft; the roots of the 24 fan blades sit in slots round its rim.

parts.name: Fan blades
parts.note: 24 wide blades, twisted from root to tip. The fan draws air in and pushes most of it back through the bypass duct; the rest goes into the core.

parts.name: Low-pressure compressor drum
parts.note: 3 stages of rotor blades (30, 32 and 34) on a drum fixed to the low-pressure shaft, so they turn with the fan; they begin to compress the air going into the core.

parts.name: Low-pressure compressor, stage 1
parts.note: the row of 30 rotor blades of stage 1, turning with the fan.

parts.name: Low-pressure compressor, stage 2
parts.note: the row of 32 rotor blades of stage 2, turning with the fan.

parts.name: Low-pressure compressor, stage 3
parts.note: the row of 34 rotor blades of stage 3, turning with the fan.

parts.name: Low-pressure turbine drum
parts.note: 4 stages of rotor blades (36, 38, 40 and 42), longer towards the back as the gas expands. The hot gas turns the turbine; the low-pressure shaft carries the turning forward to the fan and the low-pressure compressor.

parts.name: Low-pressure turbine, stage 1
parts.note: the row of 36 rotor blades of stage 1; the gas expands, so its blades are longer than the stage before.

parts.name: Low-pressure turbine, stage 2
parts.note: the row of 38 rotor blades of stage 2; the gas expands, so its blades are longer than the stage before.

parts.name: Low-pressure turbine, stage 3
parts.note: the row of 40 rotor blades of stage 3; the gas expands, so its blades are longer than the stage before.

parts.name: Low-pressure turbine, stage 4
parts.note: the row of 42 rotor blades of stage 4; the gas expands, so its blades are longer than the stage before.

parts.name: Low-pressure shaft
parts.note: the long inner shaft, from the low-pressure turbine at the back to the fan and the low-pressure compressor at the front. It runs through the high-pressure shaft.

parts.name: High-pressure compressor drum
parts.note: 6 stages of rotor blades (26, 28, 30, 32, 34 and 36), turning faster than the fan. The air is squeezed hard; the flow path narrows, so the blades get shorter towards the back.

parts.name: High-pressure compressor, stage 1
parts.note: the row of 26 rotor blades of stage 1; shorter than the stage before, as the flow path narrows.

parts.name: High-pressure compressor, stage 2
parts.note: the row of 28 rotor blades of stage 2; shorter than the stage before, as the flow path narrows.

parts.name: High-pressure compressor, stage 3
parts.note: the row of 30 rotor blades of stage 3; shorter than the stage before, as the flow path narrows.

parts.name: High-pressure compressor, stage 4
parts.note: the row of 32 rotor blades of stage 4; shorter than the stage before, as the flow path narrows.

parts.name: High-pressure compressor, stage 5
parts.note: the row of 34 rotor blades of stage 5; shorter than the stage before, as the flow path narrows.

parts.name: High-pressure compressor, stage 6
parts.note: the row of 36 rotor blades of stage 6; shorter than the stage before, as the flow path narrows.

parts.name: High-pressure turbine
parts.note: 1 row of 40 blades, straight after the combustor, in the hottest gas. It turns the high-pressure shaft, which drives the high-pressure compressor.

parts.name: High-pressure shaft
parts.note: a short hollow shaft joining the high-pressure turbine to the high-pressure compressor. The low-pressure shaft runs inside it; the two turn at different speeds.

parts.name: Compressor case
parts.note: the front section of the core casing, round both compressors. Its outside is the inner wall of the bypass duct; its inside follows the blade tips, narrowing through the compressor.

parts.name: Compressor case (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the compressor case.

parts.name: Combustor case
parts.note: the middle section of the core casing, round the combustor; it carries the highest pressure in the engine.

parts.name: Combustor case (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the combustor case.

parts.name: Turbine case
parts.note: the rear section of the core casing, round both turbines; the turbine stator rows are fixed to its inside.

parts.name: Turbine case (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the turbine case.

parts.name: Low-pressure compressor stator ring
parts.note: 3 rows of stator vanes (36, 38 and 40) between the rotor rows: they turn the flow and change its speed into pressure. This is the ring that carries them.

parts.name: Low-pressure compressor stator ring (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the low-pressure compressor stator ring.

parts.name: Low-pressure compressor stators, stage 1
parts.note: the row of 36 stator vanes of stage 1 (two halves, fixed to the two halves of the casing).

parts.name: Low-pressure compressor stators, stage 1 (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the low-pressure compressor stators, stage 1.

parts.name: Low-pressure compressor stators, stage 2
parts.note: the row of 38 stator vanes of stage 2 (two halves, fixed to the two halves of the casing).

parts.name: Low-pressure compressor stators, stage 2 (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the low-pressure compressor stators, stage 2.

parts.name: Low-pressure compressor stators, stage 3
parts.note: the row of 40 stator vanes of stage 3 (two halves, fixed to the two halves of the casing).

parts.name: Low-pressure compressor stators, stage 3 (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the low-pressure compressor stators, stage 3.

parts.name: High-pressure compressor stators, stage 1
parts.note: 6 rows of stator vanes (30, 32, 34, 36, 38 and 40) fixed to the compressor case, each behind a row of rotor blades. This is the row of stage 1.

parts.name: High-pressure compressor stators, stage 1 (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the high-pressure compressor stators, stage 1.

parts.name: High-pressure compressor stators, stage 2
parts.note: the row of 32 stator vanes of stage 2 (two halves, fixed to the two halves of the casing).

parts.name: High-pressure compressor stators, stage 2 (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the high-pressure compressor stators, stage 2.

parts.name: High-pressure compressor stators, stage 3
parts.note: the row of 34 stator vanes of stage 3 (two halves, fixed to the two halves of the casing).

parts.name: High-pressure compressor stators, stage 3 (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the high-pressure compressor stators, stage 3.

parts.name: High-pressure compressor stators, stage 4
parts.note: the row of 36 stator vanes of stage 4 (two halves, fixed to the two halves of the casing).

parts.name: High-pressure compressor stators, stage 4 (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the high-pressure compressor stators, stage 4.

parts.name: High-pressure compressor stators, stage 5
parts.note: the row of 38 stator vanes of stage 5 (two halves, fixed to the two halves of the casing).

parts.name: High-pressure compressor stators, stage 5 (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the high-pressure compressor stators, stage 5.

parts.name: High-pressure compressor stators, stage 6
parts.note: the row of 40 stator vanes of stage 6 (two halves, fixed to the two halves of the casing).

parts.name: High-pressure compressor stators, stage 6 (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the high-pressure compressor stators, stage 6.

parts.name: Combustor outer liner
parts.note: a ring-shaped chamber round the shaft. Fuel sprayed in burns in the compressed air and heats it strongly; a higher throttle sprays more fuel. This is its outer wall and dome.

parts.name: Combustor outer liner (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the combustor outer liner.

parts.name: Combustor inner liner
parts.note: the inner wall of the ring-shaped combustor; small holes in it let cooler air in to cool the wall.

parts.name: Combustor inner liner (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the combustor inner liner.

parts.name: Burning gas
parts.note: the very hot gas in the combustor; brighter as the throttle goes up.

parts.name: Burning gas (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the burning gas.

parts.name: Fuel nozzles
parts.note: 20 nozzles (two halves of 10) on a fuel ring round the combustor, spraying fine jets of fuel into its front.

parts.name: Fuel nozzles (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the fuel nozzles.

parts.name: Igniter plug
parts.note: a rod through the case into the combustor: it sparks to light the fuel when the engine starts.

parts.name: Igniter plug (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the igniter plug.

parts.name: Nozzle guide vanes
parts.note: 1 row of 24 nozzle guide vanes before the high-pressure turbine and 4 rows of stator vanes (32, 34, 36 and 38) in the low-pressure turbine: they direct the hot gas onto the rotor blades. This is the row before the high-pressure turbine.

parts.name: Nozzle guide vanes (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the nozzle guide vanes.

parts.name: Low-pressure turbine stators, stage 1
parts.note: the row of 32 stator vanes of stage 1 (two halves, fixed to the two halves of the casing).

parts.name: Low-pressure turbine stators, stage 1 (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the low-pressure turbine stators, stage 1.

parts.name: Low-pressure turbine stators, stage 2
parts.note: the row of 34 stator vanes of stage 2 (two halves, fixed to the two halves of the casing).

parts.name: Low-pressure turbine stators, stage 2 (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the low-pressure turbine stators, stage 2.

parts.name: Low-pressure turbine stators, stage 3
parts.note: the row of 36 stator vanes of stage 3 (two halves, fixed to the two halves of the casing).

parts.name: Low-pressure turbine stators, stage 3 (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the low-pressure turbine stators, stage 3.

parts.name: Low-pressure turbine stators, stage 4
parts.note: the row of 38 stator vanes of stage 4 (two halves, fixed to the two halves of the casing).

parts.name: Low-pressure turbine stators, stage 4 (far half)
parts.note: the far half of the low-pressure turbine stators, stage 4.

parts.name: Exhaust nozzle
parts.note: the duct narrowing behind the turbine; the core's hot gas leaves it at high speed.

parts.name: Exhaust cone
parts.note: the cone in the middle of the nozzle, smoothing the hot gas as it leaves the engine.

parts.name: Accessory gearbox
parts.note: under the fan case; takes a drive from the engine's shaft to run the fuel pump, the oil pump, the generator and the starter.

parts.name: Fuel pump
parts.note: at the front of the gearbox; pushes fuel to the nozzles.

parts.name: Starter
parts.note: at the back of the gearbox; turns the high-pressure shaft at start-up until the engine runs by itself.

parts.name: Oil tank
parts.note: holds the oil that lubricates the bearings; the oil is pumped round the engine and back to the tank.

parts.name: Oil pipe
parts.note: joins the oil tank to the oil pump in the gearbox.

parts.name: Wiring harness
parts.note: wires running round the fan case, joining the engine's sensors to its control unit.

parts.name: Front mount
parts.note: where the engine is bolted to the pylon under the wing, on top of the fan case; the thrust passes through here to the aeroplane.

parts.name: Rear mount
parts.note: the second mount, on top of the turbine case; with the front mount it holds the engine under the wing.
